ATIpiu/PiuLink-Community.body:
# PiuLink

PiuLink lets you connect to your own computer from a phone, tablet, TV, or another computer to use the desktop and apps remotely, and you can also play games with a controller. The host side is based on Sunshine, and the client is compatible with Moonlight. Resolution, aspect ratio, and frame rate depend on the display, encoding hardware, and network conditions.

[Watch the short film (1:03)](https://atipiu.github.io/PiuLink-Community/#film) · [Go to the official website to download](https://atipiu.github.io/PiuLink-Community/#downloads)

## PiuLink Rust New Mainline

PiuLink Rust is a completely new development version. Starting with this release, all future optimizations, fixes, and feature iterations will be based on the new main branch. Old forks, old commits, and PRs based on the old mainline will not be accepted for merging. Developers who want to keep contributing should create a new fork or branch from the new main, reimplement the changes they need, and submit a new PR.

[Notes for this major release](https://github.com/ATIpiu/PiuLink-Community/releases/tag/rust-2026.11.28) · [Rust streaming core](https://github.com/ATIpiu/PiuLink-Community/blob/HEAD/engines/rust/) · [Contributing guide](https://github.com/ATIpiu/PiuLink-Community/blob/HEAD/CONTRIBUTING.md) · [Old mainline archive](https://github.com/ATIpiu/PiuLink-Community/tree/history/pre-rust-main-20261127)

AmbaRu/rizpaq.description: ZPAQ power without the console. Desktop archiver for Windows: versioned ZPAQ backups, PAR2 protection, ZIP/7z/RAR support. GUI for zpaqfranz.
AmbaRu/rizpaq.body:
# Rizpaq

**ZPAQ power without the console. One app for every archive you own.**

Rizpaq is a desktop archiver for Windows. It puts the full strength of
[zpaqfranz](https://github.com/fcorbelli/zpaqfranz) — file versions, global
deduplication, one of the best compression ratios available — behind a clean,
familiar interface. Alongside it, Rizpaq opens, extracts, and *converts*
ZIP, 7z, and RAR archives, so a single tool covers what used to need three.

Every archive can also be wrapped into a **PAR2 recovery set** kept
right next to it: background bit-rot becomes a detectable, repairable
problem instead of a silent loss.

No install. No console. No scripting. Three engines are built in.

---

## What problem does it solve

### "I want my files to have a history, not just a copy"

An ordinary archive is a snapshot: one moment, frozen. Restore it next year
and you get *that* moment back — every file, all of it, or nothing.

Free Apple ID signing typically expires after 7 days. When the app won't open after expiration, reconnect the iPhone and press `Cmd + R` in Xcode to reinstall and renew the signing for 7 more days:

```bash
cd /Users/max/Desktop/github/interview
source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22
npx cap open ios
```

If you're only renewing the signing without changing content, you don't need to rebuild the web artifacts.

If you've modified the blog content, you need to rebuild and sync first:

cd /Users/max/Desktop/github/interview

source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22.22.2

Trojankill/Safe-server-lists-for-bypassi.body:
# 🛡️ VPN Config Security Filter

---

### 🔬 Parsing and normalization

- ✅ **URI parser instead of regex** — vless / vmess / trojan / hysteria2 / ss / tuic are parsed into a structure
- ✅ **Double decoding** — `&amp;`, `\u0026`, `%5Cu0026`, `¬`
- ✅ **Invisible characters** — zero-width, BOM, `\n`, control chars are stripped before checking
- ✅ **Parameter synonyms** — `allowlnsecure` (with a lowercase L), `skip-cert-verify`, `skip_cert_verify`, `insecure`
- ✅ **Lowercase scheme** — `VLESS://` no longer breaks parsing
- ✅ **Insecurity flags** — any value other than an explicit `0/false/no/off` is treated as enabled
- ✅ **vmess `"tls":"none"`** — no longer passes as valid TLS
- ✅ **Duplicates before limits** — one node with different names no longer pushes out legitimate configs

oimasterkafuu/Roka.body:
# Roka

Roka is a real-time grid-based territory war game, similar in gameplay to generals.io. Players expand their territory, build main bases and command posts, and in FFA or team matches, capture the enemy's main base and survive to the end.

The server is built with TypeScript, Fastify, and Socket.IO, and the frontend is mainly native JavaScript. Matches are settled by the server on a per-Tick basis, with support for reconnection after disconnection, spectating, and full replays.

## Main Features

- Real-time FFA and team matches, with multiple maps, map sizes, random seeds, and three fog modes (default: normal).
- Visible neutral swamps use a light gray background slightly brighter than empty ground. Captured swamps keep the player's color, and outside of vision they still display in the original fog style.
- In real-time matches, use the arrow keys to move the cursor and WASD to push troops. Numeric formation groups 0–19 are only valid for the current match. Multi-front battles support multi-selection and synchronized troop pushes. See `/tutorial` for shortcuts.
- In real-time matches, the red box during the burst period of Ticks 26–50 is only shown in single-front play. Multi-front battles have no burst period and do not show the red box.
- When an isolated cell reconnects, it doubles only if its current troop count is greater than 1 and no troops reinforced it during its isolation. A cell with 1 troop stays at 1, and a cell that has been reinforced keeps its current troop count.
- User registration and login, Rating, points, personal profile pages, activity feeds, comments, and promotion ambassadors.
- Room chat, real-time online status, browser notifications, and an admin dashboard.
- Replay viewing, downloading, local upload, and querying historical replays by user and date.
- GitHub account binding and Star-based gold highlighting for the top half of players. The About page publicly displays contributors and all Star supporters.
- Strategy bots that can run independently or be hosted by the server. Protocol documentation is at `/develop/bot`.
- Rooms containing official hosted bots can choose "Normal" or "Easy" AI difficulty.
- First-visit intro video, static asset CDN, and origin fallback on failure.

## Canyon Corridor

Maze mode generates corridors, main bases, and swamps together based on the actual number of participants. It selects locations within multiple connected mazes that have loops, avoids dead ends where possible, and, while preserving spacing between engagements, prioritizes improving flat troop-producing ground within radius 6 and 10 steps of the weakest player. Territory is divided by shortest path to the main base, with tied cells split evenly. Swamps are preferentially placed in areas far from the opening expansion range that have a larger share of flat ground. The final main base positions are assigned to seats only after an independent seed shuffle.

The maze keeps only the current generation and initialization path. No compatibility copies, version markers, or dual paths are retained for old algorithms or old replays. Real-time matches and operation replays use the same map generation and seat assignment rules; operation replays are rebuilt directly under the current rules. Already-encoded viewing frames, other maps, and room settings are unchanged.

redcatH/HollyMusic.body:
# Holly Music

**A self-hosted music player compatible with LX Music sources.**

Search, discover, and save music on your computer and phone, and keep your playlists and listening history on your own server.

[Quick Deployment](#快速部署) · [Interface Preview](#界面预览) · [Audio Quality & Playback](#音质与播放) · [Platform Plugins & Soda Music](#平台插件与汽水音乐) · [User Guide](#使用文档) · [Community & Contributing](#交流与贡献)

## Why Holly Music

- **Reuse existing sources**. Import LX Music custom source scripts to provide playback and downloads for the selected platforms.
- **Extend search and discovery**. A single platform plugin script can provide single-track search, playlists, charts, or roaming content for multiple platforms.
- **Test sources before use**: check by platform and quality, run full inspection and preview, and import or update only after confirmation. Supports downloading a backup of the current script.
- **Bring your own playlists**: import NetEase Cloud Music CSV or public QQ Music playlists, and follow playlists that update with the platform. Song favorites support searching by song title, artist, or album.
- **Works well on computer and phone**: responsive interface, light and dark themes, immersive lyrics, and PWA offline listening with lock-screen playback controls. Where the browser supports it, foreground keep-awake playback can be enabled.
- **Adjust sound to your taste**: ten-band equalizer with built-in and custom presets, available on the web and PWA.
- **Suited for individuals and families**: Docker deployment and multi-account use. Favorites, playlists, and listening history are managed separately.

Also supports AI-assisted playlist creation, song sharing, downloads, server-side audio caching, and Subsonic client access. [View full features →](https://github.com/redcatH/HollyMusic/blob/HEAD/docs/USER-GUIDE.md)

## Interface Preview

Screenshots come from the current interface and use demo playlists and original sample lyrics. Platform names are obscured, and covers use mosaic placeholders without third-party marks.

The following features can be tried in the `v0.33.0` preview series. On desktop, click the quality button on the bottom playback bar. On mobile, open More → Quality to set playback preferences. # MoonCheck

MoonCheck provides automatic check-in for UESTC's 晚安成电 (Good Night UESTC). It keeps the ESP32 powered and connected, so the device runs on schedule and you no longer need to manually open the page at a set time and place every day. It supports group leader team confirmation and individual location check-in.

[Download v0.9.0 firmware and PC Bluetooth console](https://github.com/richard297779/UESTC-MoonCheck/releases/tag/v0.9.0)

## Safety Notes

- **Group leaders** confirm every day that each group member can be reached. When someone cannot be contacted or their situation needs verification, pause that round's automatic task first, then verify and report as the school requires.
- **Individual check-in** uses your own account. Make sure you can be reached that night. When your location or actual circumstances change, handle it promptly and manually as the school requires.
- Use in accordance with school regulations. Configure your own device only in a controlled environment, and safeguard your passwords, browser fingerprints, WeChat credentials, and push keys.

Syntax Analyzer is a web application that automatically analyzes various syntactic structures of English sentences and lets you edit them into any form you like. xheiop/hexo-theme-instapaper.body:
# hexo-theme-instapaper

A minimalist Hexo theme inspired by Instapaper

## Theme Preview

[Demo](https://duyu.page)

## Feature

- Supports switching DarkMode (follows the system by default; remembers the choice after manual switching)
- Native image lazy loading (`loading="lazy"`)
- Mobile-friendly

## TODO

- Multi-language support

## Comments

Comments use [giscus](https://giscus.app/zh-CN) (based on GitHub Discussions). Before use, you need: a public repository, Discussions enabled, the [giscus app](https://github.com/apps/giscus) installed, and then enter the repository name on the giscus website to get `repoId` and `categoryId`.

To disable comments for a single post: add `comments: false` in the front-matter.

> Migrating from the old gitalk version: gitalk comments are stored in Issues, while giscus reads from Discussions, so old comments will not display automatically. If needed, you can convert issues to discussions on GitHub, and adjust titles according to giscus's `mapping` rules.

## Environment Requirements

- Hexo 7 and above (tested on Hexo 8)
- The template uses Pug, so you need to install the renderer in the blog directory:

```
npm install hexo-renderer-pug
```

- The RSS link in the navigation points to `/atom.xml`, which requires [hexo-generator-feed](https://github.com/hexojs/hexo-generator-feed)

## Install the Theme

Go to your own Hexo blog directory and clone the theme code into the blog directory:

```
git clone https://github.com/techmovie/hexo-theme-instapaper.git themes/instapaper --depth=1
```

In the `_config.yml` of the Hexo directory, change the value of `theme` to `instapaper`.

## Theme Configuration

It is recommended to create a new `_config.instapaper.yml` in the blog root directory to write theme configuration (supported in Hexo 5+). This way, updating the theme will not conflict with the `_config.yaml` in the theme directory. The configuration items are as follows:
